basic_details.job_title: DCPU Chennai South Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Legal cum Probation Officer, Counsellor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Child Protection Unit, Chennai South, set up under the Department of Children Welfare and Special Services, has invited applications for four posts on a purely contractual basis for one year: one each of Legal-cum-Probation Officer, Counsellor, Assistant-cum-Data Entry Operator and Outreach Worker. Filled-in forms must reach the District Child Protection Officer, Alandur, Chennai, by post or in person, on or before 5:45 PM on 27 November 2026.

age_limit.details: All four posts: the applicant must be below 42 years of age at the time of application. The notice does not list any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: About District Child Protection Unit, Chennai South
content_sections.text: The District Child Protection Unit, Chennai South, is established under the Department of Children Welfare and Special Services. Its office for this recruitment is at the GCC Commercial Complex, Alandur, Chennai. The press release was published by the Information and Public Relations Officer, Collectorate Campus, Chennai District.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit the duly filled-in prescribed application form, with a recent photograph and self-attested copies of the required certificates/documents, either by post or in person. The application must reach the following address on or before 5:45 PM on 27.11.2026: District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, Chennai – South, No. 1, New Street, GCC Commercial Complex, First Floor, Alandur, Chennai – 600 016 (Near RTO Office) The application form and the detailed notification can be downloaded from the official Chennai District website, https://chennai.nic.in . Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. The notice does not print an envelope superscription or a postal mode.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The total is 4 posts. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up. Qualification: a degree in Law from a recognised university. Experience: minimum of 2 years of work experience in a Government organisation or Non-Governmental Organisation (NGO) working in the field of women's and children's rights. Qualification: a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Psychology, Public Health, Counselling. Experience: minimum of 1 year of work experience in a Government organisation or NGO working in the field of women's and children's rights. Skill: computer operating skills. Qualification: passed Higher Secondary (12th Standard) from a recognised board or an equivalent board. Certificate in Computer Operations and Tally or Typewriting. Experience: minimum of 1 year of work experience. Qualification: passed Higher Secondary (12th Standard). Preference will be given to candidates having experience in communication skills. All four posts: the applicant must be below 42 years of age at the time of application. The notice does not list any age relaxation. The posts are on a purely contractual basis for a period of one year. The notice describes the posts as purely temporary and contractual in nature. Candidates should check the detailed notification on the official website for any further post-specific eligibility.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the District Child Protection Unit, Chennai South recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies, one post each of Legal-cum-Probation Officer, Counsellor, Assistant-cum-Data Entry Operator and Outreach Worker.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Child Protection Officer on or before 5:45 PM on 27.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Legal-cum-Probation Officer post?
faq.answer: A degree in Law from a recognised university and a minimum of 2 years of work experience in a Government organisation or NGO working in the field of women's and children's rights.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Outreach Worker post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have passed Higher Secondary (12th Standard). Preference will be given to candidates having experience in communication skills.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The applicant must be below 42 years of age at the time of application, for all four posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly remuneration for each post?
faq.answer: Legal-cum-Probation Officer 27,804; Counsellor 18,536; Assistant-cum-Data Entry Operator 13,240; Outreach Worker 10,592.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed form from https://chennai.nic.in, fill it in, attach a recent photograph and self-attested copies of the required certificates/documents, and send it by post or hand it in at the office in Alandur, Chennai.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application must be submitted for each post.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on a purely contractual basis for a period of one year and are described as purely temporary and contractual in nature.
